0022600021.text: The Mavericks (2-2, 9th in the West, 2.5 games back in the Southwest, 4th in the division) host the unbeaten Rockets (5-0, 1st in the West and the Southwest), with Dallas on a W1 streak at home 0-1 and Houston on a W5 streak on the road 3-0 and at home 2-0. The 2026-27 season series has Dallas trailing 0-1 after a 128-110 loss in Houston on October 21, and the two teams split 2-2 in 2025-26. Dallas is without Dereck Lively II, Naji Marshall, Santi Aldama, Sergio de Larrea and Tarik Biberovic, while Houston is missing Alperen Sengun, Marcus Smart and Steven Adams.
